raw_segments.text: What do they think when they hear music? Way to catch rattlesnakes.
Night-Michael Gunn gave us the box, tuning up. Shove Persia like that best.
Remind him of home sweet home. Wiped his nose in curtain too.
Custom his country perhaps. That's music too. Not as bad as it sounds.
Tootling. Brasses braying asses through up trunks.
Double basses helpless. Gashes in their sides.
Woodwinds mooing cows. Semigrand open crocodile music hath jaws.
